posts.title: Teardown: Rivian R1S Autonomy eXperience Module (AXM) 1.0
posts.description: Today we’ll be performing a teardown and analysis of the Rivian “Autonomy eXperience Module”, or AXM. The AXM is a core part of the Rivian R1S and R1T vehicles, controlling driver assistance, media playback, infotainment display, and essentially all ADAS/infotainment tasks in the vehicle!

posts.title: Car Hacking and Vulnerability Reporting in 2026
posts.description: Now that we’re fresh into the start of 2026, I thought it would be interesting to take a look back at the state of automotive cybersecurity. To do this, I wanted to answer the question of: What is the state of automotive vulnerability reporting in 2026?
